title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin climbs 3.3 percent to sixty-six thousand two hundred seventy-eight dollars even as fear and greed sits at twenty-five in extreme fear territory. The move higher extended through the Asia session on steady buying.

Network hashrate remains firm at nine hundred eleven exahashes. Mempool congestion shows eighty-nine thousand pending transactions with fees still cheap at two satoshis per byte.

Watch whether the fear gauge rebounds or volume finally prints higher today. Block height at nine
